# ProKit Studio Feature List

This is the canonical user-facing list of functional features shipped in this boilerplate.

## Included Features

1. Next.js App Router + TypeScript runtime foundation.
   - Code: `package.json`, `src/app/layout.tsx`
2. Tailwind CSS + SCSS styling pipeline.
   - Code: `tailwind.config.ts`, `src/assets/styles/globals.scss`, `postcss.config.js`
3. Tokenized theme system with light/dark support.
   - Code: `src/assets/styles/globals.scss`, `src/components/providers.tsx`
4. Global typography system:
   - Body/UI: Host Grotesk
   - Brand: Golos Text
   - Code: JetBrains Mono
   - Code: `src/styles/fonts.ts`, `src/assets/styles/globals.scss`, `tailwind.config.ts`
5. Reusable UI primitives and style utilities.
   - Code: `src/components/ui/button.tsx`, `src/components/ui/input.tsx`, `src/helpers/utils.ts`
6. Public entry pages: `/` and `/setup`.
   - Code: `src/app/page.tsx`, `src/app/setup/page.tsx`
7. App route group with shared application layout.
   - Code: `src/app/(app)/layout.tsx`
8. Custom error surfaces (`not-found` and app error boundary).
   - Code: `src/app/not-found.tsx`, `src/app/error.tsx`
9. Sticky app header with auth-aware navigation.

## Intentional Non-Goals

ProKit Studio is a core runtime boilerplate and intentionally does not include:

- Marketing/funnel/blog content systems
- CMS authoring workflows
- Built-in multi-tenant schema/user lifecycle automation

## Optional Feature Note

Some features are intentionally optional and require valid environment variables to be active:

- Clerk (auth)
- Stripe (billing)
- Resend (email)
